constitution: Q/M is terminal under current admitted custody. AO-FTK-0 freezes a sparse inventory/margin transition basis only. Full W3 and abstention remain law. No outcomes, no capital, no Q/M composites, no invented fundamentals. Success is a preregistered pre-open contract — not alpha, not a leaderboard, not gate-filling theater.
